correctness.rationale: Rank-one factorization R(a)=phi(a)v and the defining identity imply v is radical and phi annihilates vE+Ev; the converse is checked directly. Image-line stratification in P(J) gives one socle line with q^3-1 maps and q^2+q nonsocle lines with q^2-1 maps each. The full algebra-automorphism group is the GL_2-action with two free z shifts. Its conjugation action is transitive on the six strata distinguished by socle image, R(1)=0, R(J)=0. All orbit counts sum to the total polynomial. Exact standalone code checked full RB equations and conjugacy orbits for F2,F3,F4; only the algebraic proof supplies all extension degrees.

value.rationale: A complete exact automorphism-orbit classification and invariant count of the canonical first nonzero rank stratum over an infinite field-extension family. The distinction between socle and nonsocle image gives structural meaning to the six types, and orbit-size polynomials resolve finite-field rational orbits not settled by real/odd-characteristic classifications or the isolated F2 enumeration. It is not a merely arbitrary numerical slice: rank-one is the intrinsic first positive rank in the operator moduli.
